thread:
jen: FYI opened PR 532 to refactor the compact metrics quickstart into a condensed dashboard example. Need a Go SDK snippet + cost/latency table. Link checkers popped 3 broken refs.

matt: nice. ping @alina for Go snippet? also which dashboard YAML do we want: full or minimal?

alina: I can do a short Go sample (10-12 lines) that mirrors the Python one. prefer minimal dashboard YAML for the quickstart page.

jen: minimal + a toggle section for 'expanded view' would be ideal. Also the cost/latency breakdown needs a small table and a note about batching SLOs.

tom: small note — the console schema changed: metric name is now `redwood.request.latency.p50` vs `latency_p50`. PR will need a rename. I'll add a changelog entry.

docs-bot: lint report: docs/quickstart/compact_metrics.md: link https://old.link/tracehook -> 404

dina: I'll sweep links and add redirects. jen, can you add a unit test that verifies sample links render? something simple.

jen: yes, adding a tiny smoke test in CI that fetches the static page and checks 200 for all links listed in frontmatter.

matt: for the Go snippet, please use the SDK's `tracehook` helper and show how to attach cost tags. e.g.

alina: sure. draft:
```go
client := redwood.NewClient(os.Getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
ctx := client.NewTraceContext("dashboard-quickstart")
ctx.SetTag("cost_center","playground")
resp, _ := client.Dashboards().Render(ctx, "compact")
fmt.Println(resp.URL)
```

matt: perfect. can you include a comment about batching param `MaxBatchTokens`? small code comment.

alina: added comment in my PR branch. I'll push in ~30m.

jen: timeline: aiming to merge by EOD so internal release can pick it up tomorrow. if anyone sees blockers post here.

tom: added the metric rename change + changelog entry.

dina: link redirects created in infra, will provide canonical URLs in the PR.

jen: thanks all — will request reviews after Go snippet lands. :rocket:
